verdict.rationale: GoDaddy documents search operations for checking availability and suggesting alternative names, a concrete v3 check-availability endpoint (curl example), and a machine-readable Domains v3 OpenAPI spec. A rate-limits page says every response carries a RateLimit-Remaining header, and an official MCP server gives agents availability checks. Missing for 10: the actual rate-limit quotas or window sizes (only the header is evidenced), and any independent or hands-on corroboration of the availability API.
